name: nova-agent-kit
description: Skill and generated agent adapters for working with Wandelbots NOVA through the nova CLI

scripts.validate:plugin: claude plugin validate --strict plugin && claude plugin validate --strict plugin-nova-bot && claude plugin validate --strict .
scripts.validate:skill: uvx --from skills-ref agentskills validate plugin/skills/nova && uvx --from skills-ref agentskills validate .agents/skills/nova
scripts.check: pnpm build && git diff --exit-code -- plugin plugin-nova-bot .agents .claude-plugin && pnpm test && pnpm lint:md && pnpm validate:plugin && pnpm validate:skill
